proof.scope: Selected execution paths inspected, not exhaustive whole-repository audit

accepted_direction: One Handshake-wide owner and explicit implementation gap
Same-build Rust, nonRT WIT and explicit core-Wasm compatibility lanes

corrections.text: Instance/store/helper pools MUST be scoped to principal, resource grant, artifact hash and state version. Crossing a trust scope requires a fresh instance or independently proven complete reset. Revocation MUST discard retained private guest/helper memory and deny output promotion; immutable compiled artifacts may be shared without live grants or content state.
corrections.reason: Aggregate budgets and current authorization do not prevent guest memory from one account influencing another account.

corrections.text: Event contributions MUST use bounded asynchronous dispatch with cause IDs, maximum propagation depth, duplicate suppression and per-plugin budgets. Host locks MUST NOT be held across guest or vendor callbacks; cancellation/completion capacity remains reserved. Replayed or recursive events MUST NOT create duplicate accepted mutations.
corrections.reason: Typed bounded messages alone do not constrain synchronous feedback or event cycles.

corrections.text: Native editor embedding, accessibility, Argus inspection and headless parameter control MUST be separate per-host compatibility entries. Unsupported foreign UI MUST return explicit unsupported outcome; quiet automated operation MUST NOT raise vendor windows. Canonical typed parameters/commands and manual recovery remain required for the supported subset.
corrections.reason: DSP compatibility does not establish model-operable foreign editor behavior.

corrections.text: Explicitly amend the source-ecosystem exclusion in STU-AUT-020 only for the operator-approved, isolated CLAP/VST3 adapter scope. Preserve other exclusions and require exact supported ABI, architecture, sandbox, lifecycle and UI matrices; discovery alone is not compatibility.
corrections.reason: Generic add-native-limits wording leaves the existing exclusion unresolved.

corrections.target: required_controls PLATFORM-01/02/10 and shared sandbox acceptance
corrections.text: If child creation succeeds but START ledger or process-registry registration fails, the shared sandbox owner MUST retain cleanup ownership and either compensate kill/reap or return an explicit live cleanup handle. Error return MUST NOT imply absent child; permits remain held until confirmed retirement.
corrections.reason: Actual existing spawn failure path can lose the caller handle; generic quiescence requirement needs this specific rollback edge.

corrections.target: required_controls PLATFORM-09 and native state acceptance
corrections.text: State capture/restore MUST expose outcomes for each required component/controller phase. Failed required capture MUST preserve prior state and MUST NOT become empty success. Failed required restore MUST prevent complete success and accepted document commit; optional-state policy MUST be explicit.
corrections.reason: Typed complete/partial language should name the observed silently ignored controller failures.

corrections.text: Portable host-neutral foundations MUST execute minimal platform lifecycle and adapter operations with explicit provider dependencies before domain feature implementation. Second-host proof verifies portability only; production Handshake authorization, sandbox, manual/Argus and canonical state paths require separate independent acceptance.
corrections.reason: Executable portable fixtures cannot discharge production embedding and cannot allow hollow foundations.

Sandbox adapter registry; unapproved Windows Native Jail reports unavailable, rather than becoming a supported sandbox.
Bespoke core Wasm ABI, module/memory/recursion/fuel limits, no imports, fresh store; deadline checked between resumable fuel slices.
Global capped 64 OnceLock plugin slots; globally keyed ID/specs and leaked strings/spec allocations, no removal/replacement path in inspected registration functions.

One-GiB per-instance memory limit; idle-instance Vec pool, new instances on empty pool, successful instances returned without aggregate admission limit in inspected code; memory survives successful reuse.
Discovery loads each bundle and queries classes; processwide scan lock, ambient/default directories and extra_dirs, leaked information, failed-ID cache.
Processwide Bundle Arc cache intentionally retains loaded libraries; Bundle::load/open executes foreign module/factory code.
Unsafe Send Instance explicitly documents UI-affinity limitation when activation/controller calls occur after transfer to mixer; state uses foreign component/controller calls.
Drop tears down editor/controller/component; EditorLink mutex and main-thread editor opening, including raising visible window.
AUT155-162 prescribe common plugin contract, closed extension/event sets, namespace/private-shared semantics, ResourceBroker account/plugin local store, isolated typed UI and headless operations.
AUT017-020 prescribe common typed object model, process-tier default, explicit grants and promotion gates; local registry lifecycle; importing source-suite plugin ecosystems currently out of scope.

Controller capture failure becomes empty default; controller setComponentState/setState return ignored; load_state returns true after component success.

findings.title: Surface extension seam is not a platform implementation
findings.counterexample: A second host registers native callbacks but cannot install, revoke, remove or replay a plugin without depending on Handshake-native AppState.
minimum_controls: Handshake-wide platform owns registry and lifecycle; Studio is adapter only; explicit host capabilities and unsupported results; no private Score catalog, DB, scheduler or library.
All platform foundations must have executable minimal lifecycle paths before domain feature implementation.
future_acceptance: Two host adapters execute install/activate/invoke/revoke/remove through the same owner; absent capabilities fail closed; inventory every production caller.

findings.title: Native discovery executes foreign code
findings.counterexample: A bundle in ambient VST3_PATH hangs or crashes module initialization during a registry scan holding shared locks; installing becomes code execution before consent.
minimum_controls: Discovery, probing and processing in owned isolated helper with bounded IPC; never load vendor library in Studio/UI/authority process.
ResourceBroker-selected approved paths and content hashes; no ambient default scanning; unavailable process sandbox returns unsupported.
No locks held across foreign entrypoints; timeouts, quarantine and explicit retry policy.
future_acceptance: Crash/hang/malicious discovery cases leave authority and UI responsive; sandbox-unavailable host fails without in-process fallback; discovery emits bounded privacy-safe receipts.

findings.title: Native thread and lifetime guarantees need enforcement
findings.counterexample: Activation or controller/state/destructor work migrates to audio thread; a returned editor callback outlives its instance or blocks realtime processing.
minimum_controls: Explicit UI/control/audio ownership state machine and vendor ABI-specific thread rules; no native Rust ABI assumption.
Audio callback has preallocated bounded data only; no RPC wait, allocation, state save, lock, unload or destructor.
Quiescence barrier, generation-tagged handles, no callbacks after revocation; teardown on designated owner.
future_acceptance: Trace exact vendor calls and teardown ordering through rapid stop/reload/editor close; helper crash produces bounded fallback; no RT destructor or foreign pointer reuse.

findings.title: Global permanent registrations defeat update and removal
findings.counterexample: After remove/update the old plugin remains globally addressable or occupies its slot; replacing a file changes discovery identity without changing executable authority.
minimum_controls: Canonical registry record keyed by account/plugin/version/content hash and activation generation; derive projections.
Install/update/remove atomic states, operation IDs and retry deduplication through existing authority/EventLedger; invalidate invocation and state handles on transition.
Bound registry metadata and explicit controlled retention; helper exit reclaims vendor caches.
future_acceptance: Update/remove/retry/rollback and restart preserve one canonical selected generation; old handles deny; 64-slot exhaustion reported explicitly.

findings.title: Per-instance Wasm limits do not bound aggregate pressure
findings.counterexample: Concurrent renders each obtain a new one-GiB-capable instance; large frames and buffers exhaust memory despite valid per-instance fuel limits.
minimum_controls: ResourceBroker/JobRuntime aggregate byte, concurrency, queue and compile limits; bound pool size and idle memory; admission before allocations.
Separate realtime and offline/nonRT profiles; format/dimension arithmetic checked; stage parameters and pixels under content-class grants.
future_acceptance: Concurrent adversarial frames cannot exceed admitted bytes; overflow/oversize reject before allocate; saturated queue preserves cancellation and fair progress.

findings.title: Reused guest memory can cross privacy boundaries
findings.counterexample: An Effect guest retains previous account pixels in linear memory and emits them in a later render; plugin state or manifest-derived logs reveal private content.
minimum_controls: Fresh instance per principal/content-grant boundary or proven complete reset; never share unsanitized instance/state across accounts.
Reauthorize current grant at enqueue, dispatch and output promotion; revoke queued/running access and destroy retained guest/helper buffers.
State blobs and caches classified ResourceBroker resources, no document secrets or plugin-owned shadow DB.
future_acceptance: Cross-account retained-memory/state attack; mid-run revocation denies output promotion and subsequent reads; logs/diagnostics do not carry unauthorized pixels/state.

findings.title: Wasm SDK migration cannot inherit realtime or capability safety
findings.counterexample: A new WIT host import blocks while holding authority or allocates unbounded data; fuel and epoch controls stop guest instructions but not the blocking host function.
minimum_controls: Versioned WIT/Component nonRT profile with explicit imports, resource handles, grants, budgets and bounded asynchronous host calls; no WASI ambient authority.
Photo pc_* and Effect ec_* are different existing core Wasm ABIs; adaptation requires contract/version checks, not rename.
Real-time extensions need separately validated restricted processing protocol and deterministic resource bounds.
future_acceptance: Blocking host-call cancellation, recursion, allocation, invalid handles and schema version mismatch adversarial checks; native realtime evidence separate from offline guest success.

findings.title: UI/manual observability is not inherited from foreign editors
findings.counterexample: Vendor floating UI steals focus or is invisible to Argus/headless commands; a successful DSP load is reported as full plugin UI compatibility.
minimum_controls: Typed contributed commands and generic parameter UI under Argus/UserManual; namespace identifiers; quiet operation by default.
Host matrix independently declares foreign editor, accessibility, diagnostics and headless limitations; unsupported UI cannot become parity claim.
future_acceptance: No-context agent can enumerate/install/invoke/recover through typed commands and manual; focus and editor availability verified per supported host.

findings.title: Event callbacks can form unbounded feedback loops
findings.counterexample: A plugin subscribes to a shared mutation then emits another mutation synchronously; event replay causes recursion or duplicate promotion.
minimum_controls: Closed event/extension enum and schema negotiation; capability checks per operation.
Bounded async queues, cause IDs/depth, deduplication and dispatch budgets using existing owners; never synchronous plugin reentry while host locks held.
future_acceptance: Self-triggering subscriber, slow consumer, replay and revoke-under-backlog cases remain bounded and attributable.

findings.title: Current spec excludes ecosystem import
findings.counterexample: Implementation treats existing local-tool AUT020 as blanket permission for VST3/CLAP ecosystem hosting.
minimum_controls: Root must explicitly enrich scoped operator-approved native adapter contracts and resolve the existing exclusion before dependent implementation.
Record supported exact vendor ABI/platform/sandbox matrix, rejected adapters and limited capabilities; preserve existing Studio scope.
future_acceptance: Spec/MT trace maps operator approval to native adapter scope and acceptance; no imported ecosystem parity asserted from discovery alone.

findings.title: Spawn failure after child creation must retain cleanup ownership
findings.counterexample: START ledger write or starts mutex fails after successful child spawn; caller receives no process handle and assumes no child exists. Static failure-path finding, not observed live process leak.
minimum_controls: Shared sandbox owner compensates kill/reap or returns explicit live cleanup ownership; permit and registry remain charged until independent reconciliation.
Do not solve by independent per-Studio cleanup implementations.
future_acceptance: Inject ledger write and decorator lock failure after spawn; independently reread child/process registry and resource permits; zero unowned live helper.

findings.title: Native state success must include required controller phases
findings.counterexample: Required controller getState fails or setState refuses while component succeeds; saved or restored document still claims complete success.
minimum_controls: Typed per-instance/per-phase completeness; preserve previous required state; do not default failed required capture to empty blob.
Bound state bytes, identity/version and migration; required restore must succeed before accepted state/document commit.
future_acceptance: Controller refusal, absent/truncated/oversized blob and version mismatch produce typed partial/unavailable outcomes; canonical saved document and receipt independently reread.

selected_tradeoffs.choice: Compiled Rust source interfaces only within same controlled build
selected_tradeoffs.condition: Do not expose Rust ABI as stable third-party dynamic boundary.

selected_tradeoffs.choice: Versioned WIT/Component SDK for extensible nonRT work
selected_tradeoffs.condition: Explicit platform imports, capabilities, budgets and per-host support; no automatic realtime claim.
Versioned vendor C/C++ ABI, explicit thread/lifetime rules and supported process sandbox; no unsafe fallback.

selected_tradeoffs.choice: Existing authority and service owners behind ports
selected_tradeoffs.condition: SurrealDB/EventLedger sole durable authority; reuse JobRuntime/ResourceBroker/Argus/UserManual/Palmistry; no Studio/Score private duplication.

rejected_tradeoffs: Stable native Rust plugin ABI assumption
In-process untrusted vendor discovery or execution
Global permanent plugin slots as authoritative lifecycle registry
Alternative host success substituted for production Handshake proof

external_primary_sources.supports: Rust ABI has no stability guarantees; C ABI targets platform conventions.
Fuel/epoch interruption cannot interrupt blocking host functions; conceptual limitation, not claim about wasmi API.
Distinct main/audio-thread callbacks, pointer lifetimes and destruction contract.
Module initialization/deinitialization concurrency and GUI restrictions; discovery is executable entrypoint.
